items.ti: Roger Marshall 상원의원은 제가 사랑하고 2016년, 2020년, 2024년에 큰 승리를 거둔 캔자스주를 위해 믿을 수 없을 정도로 열심히 일하고 있습니다. Roger는 제가 가장 좋아하는 상원의원 중 한 명입니다. 그는 환자들에게 빚진 돈을 요구하도록 법에 의해 명령받았기 때문에 "엉터리 랩"을 받은 정말 훌륭하고 멋진 사람입니다. 이러한 요청을 하지 않으면 법을 위반하는 것이며 형사 책임을 지고 체포될 수 있습니다. 법원에 여러 번 출두하지 않았다는 이유로 환자의 체포를 명령한 판사는 Roger Marshall의 잘못이 아닙니다. 그것은 법이며 그의 비뚤어진 상대는 그를 상대로 이를 이용하고 있습니다. Roger는 "온건파"인 척하는 트럼프 미친 가짜 아담 해밀턴이라는 급진 좌파 민주당 원과 맞서고 있지만 그는 그렇지 않습니다! 그는 Kamala Harris, Crooked Joe Biden, Barack Hussein Obuma에게 돈을주었습니다. 또 무슨 말이 필요합니까? 또한 Adam Hamilton은 높은 세금, 국경 개방, No C를 좋아합니다.
items.ti_en: Senator Roger Marshall is working incredibly hard for the Great State of Kansas, which I love and WON BIG in 2016, 2020, and 2024. Roger is one of my favorite Senators — He is absolutely GREAT, a wonderful person, given a “bum rap” because he was mandated by Law to request money owed from patients. If he didn’t make these requests, he would be breaking the Law, and subject to criminal liability and arrest. A judge ordering a patient’s arrest for not showing up to court many, many times is not Roger Marshall’s fault — IT IS THE LAW, and his Crooked Opponent is using that against him. Roger is running against a Radical Left Dumocrat named Adam Hamilton, a Trump Deranged Phony who pretends to be a “Moderate,” but he’s not! He gave money to Kamala Harris, Crooked Joe Biden, and Barack Hussein Obuma — What else needs to be said? Additionally, Adam Hamilton loves High Taxes, Open Borders, No Consequences for Violent Criminals, Men in Women’s Sports, the Transgender Mutilization of your Children, among other CRAZY ideas, and says that the Great People of Kansas need to repent for eating beef (much like James TalaFREAKo, a Vegan who is running for the United States Senate in Texas). I won the Evangelical Christian Vote IN A LANDSLIDE, a Record Number, the Highest in History, and am more popular with them now, than ever before, because of what I have done, and gotten them — And I wouldn’t want Adam Hamilton being my pastor. He’s caused nothing but turmoil in his church, which has broken up, and is virtually at war with each other because of him. In his church, he has caused great anger and dissension, setting it back decades with discord and vitriol that will never be healed. “Pastor” Hamilton hired a child PREDATOR as a camp counselor, who was caught sneaking into boys' cabins at night. Hamilton DISMISSED their concerns, REFUSED to call the police, and brought this person back to camp the next year — He was caught again. DISGUSTING!As someone who got a massive Majority of the Evangelical Vote, I can state unequivocally that Adam Hamilton is not one of us! He is a Radical Left LUNATIC Dumocrat, whose values are not those of the People of Kansas, or the United States of America, and now he’s trying to take out one of the best and most respected Senators in our Country — But the good news is that Senator Roger Marshall loves the U.S.A., and is a Truly Great American Patriot, who has my Complete and Total Endorsement — HE ALWAYS HAS, AND HE ALWAYS WILL. In the U.S. Senate, Roger is fighting hard to Champion our Great Farmers and American Agriculture, Grow our Economy, Unleash American Energy Dominance, Cut Taxes and Regulations, Keep our Border SECURE, Take Care of, and Protect, our fabulous Military and Vets, and Defend our always under siege Second Amendment. Additionally, Roger is working tirelessly to pass the Credit Card Competition Act, in order to stop the out of control Swipe Fee ripoff! ROGER LOVES KANSAS, AND WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN! I will be having a Kansas Style Rally, in Roger’s Honor, very soon. See you there! President DONALD J. TRUMP
